firm_data.firm_description: FUCHS ROSENZWEIG PLLC is a team of attorneys committed to finding innovative solutions to clients' legal problems. The firm's practice includes the review, drafting, editing and negotiation of contracts.
notable_facts: The firm was founded in January 2019.
The firm aims to deliver amazing service.
The firm is looking for an experienced Associate.

email.subject: AI for FUCHS ROSENZWEIG PLLC, built for your contract work
email.body:
Hi Cheryl,

Since founding FUCHS ROSENZWEIG in January 2019, you've built a firm committed to innovative solutions for contract review, drafting, and negotiation. That focus on precision work at scale is exactly what we're seeing across growing insurance defense and commercial litigation practices.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting with New York firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on contract work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
